questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the President to declare financial emergency?
questions.explanation: Article 360 authorizes the President to declare a financial emergency.

questions.question: Which of the following is a fundamental duty under the Indian Constitution?
options: To follow the instructions of the government
To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India
To vote compulsorily in all elections
questions.explanation: It requires promoting harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India.

questions.question: The Panchayat system is enshrined in which Article of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article 243A provides for the establishment of Panchayat Raj institutions.

questions.question: Who among the following is the head of a Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe Welfare Board in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Chairperson is the head of the Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe Welfare Board in West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of the Sixth Schedule of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: It provides for the creation of Autonomous District Councils.

questions.question: Who was the first Indian to be hanged by the British in Bengal for the 1857 rebellion?
questions.explanation: He was the first to spark the Indian Rebellion of 1857.

questions.question: What was the name of the Swadeshi Movement's iconic symbol in Bengal?
questions.explanation: A red flag with eight pointed stars and the words 'Bande Mataram' on it.

questions.question: Which of the following events marked the beginning of the Quit India Movement in Bengal?
questions.explanation: The British were forced to abandon a major arms factory in Kolkata.

questions.question: Who was the prominent Bengal revolutionary associated with the Jugantar Party?
questions.explanation: He played a key role in the 1930 Chittagong Armoury Raid.

questions.question: What was the name of the Bengali newspaper that played a significant role in the Swadeshi Movement?
questions.explanation: Founded by Aurobindo Ghosh in 1906.

questions.question: Which mountain range runs through the northern part of West Bengal, India?
questions.explanation: The Eastern Himalayas traverse the northern part of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which major river originates in the Himalayas and flows through the state of West Bengal before emptying into the Bay of Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Ganges originates in the Himalayas and flows through West Bengal.

questions.question: Which delta region is located in the state of West Bengal, India?
questions.explanation: The Sunderbans is a delta region located in West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the name of the largest city and the capital of the state of West Bengal, India?
questions.explanation: Kolkata is the capital of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following hills is part of the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region in West Bengal, India?
questions.explanation: The Darjeeling Hills are part of the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region.

questions.question: Which of the following West Bengal government schemes aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for crop diversification and improvement of agricultural productivity?
questions.explanation: It is a state government scheme to promote agricultural growth.

questions.question: Which of the following is a major component of the West Bengal government's 'Project Saraswati' aimed at rejuvenating the state's water bodies?
questions.explanation: It is a component of the project to conserve soil.

questions.question: In 2025, which of the following West Bengal government's initiatives was launched to promote digital literacy among the state's rural population?
questions.explanation: It is a digital literacy initiative by the state government.

questions.question: Which of the following is a key feature of the West Bengal government's 'Mission Nabin' aimed at improving the state's healthcare infrastructure?
questions.explanation: It is a feature of the mission to improve telemedicine facilities.

questions.question: Which of the following West Bengal government schemes provides financial assistance to women entrepreneurs in the state for setting up and running their own businesses?
questions.explanation: It is a scheme to support women entrepreneurs.

questions.question: Laal Hospital Scheme is a health initiative launched by the Government of West Bengal to provide free medical treatment to which category of people?
questions.explanation: Laal Hospital Scheme aims to provide free medical treatment to all categories of people.

questions.question: The Unnayan Scheme by the Government of West Bengal focuses on the economic empowerment of which section of society?
questions.explanation: The Unnayan Scheme is designed for women's economic empowerment.

questions.question: The Bangla Sahayata Scheme is a financial assistance program introduced by the Government of West Bengal for which purpose?
questions.explanation: The Bangla Sahayata Scheme provides financial assistance for small business loans.

questions.question: The Anandadhara Scheme by the Government of West Bengal aims to provide financial assistance to which category of students?
questions.explanation: The Anandadhara Scheme provides financial assistance to students from economically backward families.

questions.question: The Swayamsidha Scheme by the Government of West Bengal focuses on the skill development and entrepreneurship of which category of women?
options: Women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families
questions.explanation: The Swayamsidha Scheme targets women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.

questions.question: If a merchant in Howrah sells an article at a profit of 20%, then the cost price of the article is what percentage of the selling price?
questions.explanation: Cost price is 80% of the selling price.

questions.question: A person buys 100 kg of potatoes at Rs 15 per kg. If he sells them at a loss of 8%, then what is the loss in rupees?
questions.explanation: Loss is Rs 1200.

questions.question: If a man in Darjeeling increases his selling price by 10%, then his profit percentage is?
questions.explanation: Profit percentage is 12%.

questions.question: A shopkeeper in Siliguri buys an article for Rs 800 and sells it for Rs 920. His profit percentage is?
questions.explanation: Profit percentage is 15%.

questions.question: A certain quantity of goods is sold at 15% profit and the selling price is Rs 210. What is the cost price of the goods?
questions.explanation: Cost price is Rs 180.

questions.question: A train travels from Howrah to Sealdah, a distance of 25 km, in 1 hour. What is the approximate speed of the train in km/hr?
questions.explanation: Speed is calculated as distance/time.

questions.question: A man walks from his house to the local market at a speed of 4 kmph and returns at a speed of 5 kmph. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
questions.explanation: Average speed is calculated as total distance/total time.

questions.question: A bus covers a distance of 120 km from Kolkata to Barasat in 3 hours. How much time will it take to cover a distance of 180 km?
questions.explanation: Time is calculated as distance/speed.

questions.question: A car travels from Siliguri to Darjeeling, a distance of 90 km, in 2.5 hours. What is the average speed of the car in km/hr?
questions.explanation: Average speed is calculated as total distance/total time.

questions.question: A motorcycle covers a distance of 80 km from Asansol to Durgapur in 2 hours. What is its average speed in km/hr?
questions.explanation: Average speed is calculated as total distance/total time.

questions.question: If the first letter of a word is changed to 'D' and the second letter is changed to 'A', then 'KOLKATA' becomes?
questions.explanation: The correct decoding is 'DOALKAT' by replacing 'K' with 'D' and 'O' with 'A'.

questions.question: If a is coded as 1, b is coded as 2, c is coded as 3, and so on, then what will be the code for 'G'?
questions.explanation: The correct code is '9' as 'G' is the 9th letter in the English alphabet.

questions.question: If the first and the last letters of a word are interchanged, then 'RAAJYOT' becomes?
questions.explanation: The correct decoding is 'YTOAJAR' by interchanging the first and last letters.

questions.question: If a word is coded as the reverse of its alphabet position, then what will be the code for 'Z'?
questions.explanation: The correct code is '26' as 'Z' is the 26th letter in the English alphabet.

questions.question: If a code is given by shifting each letter 3 places forward in the alphabet, then what will be the code for 'B'?
questions.explanation: The correct code is 'E' as 'B' shifted 3 places forward is 'E'.

questions.question: If A is the mother of B and B is the father of C, then how is A related to C?
questions.explanation: A is C's grandmother.

questions.question: A boy has three siblings, two of them are sisters. If 'M' is his paternal uncle, then how is his third sibling related to 'M'?
questions.explanation: The third sibling is M's daughter.

questions.question: A woman is the daughter of her father's brother's son. What is the relation of the woman to her father?
questions.explanation: The woman is her father's daughter.

questions.question: X is the only son of P, Y is the daughter of X and Q is the daughter of Y. What is the relation of Q to P?
questions.explanation: Q is P's granddaughter.

questions.question: A and B are brothers, C is the wife of A and D is the daughter of B. How is C related to D?
questions.explanation: C is D's mother.

questions.question: If a person walks 8 km east from a point and then walks 5 km north, he will be 10 km away from the starting point. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: He will be facing North.

questions.question: A man is standing at a crossroads. He walks 15 km in the north direction, then 10 km in the west direction and then 6 km in the south direction. In which direction is he standing now?
questions.explanation: He will be standing in the North direction.

questions.question: A man is standing at a point. He walks 15 km east, then 10 km south and then 12 km in a direction making an angle of 60° with the south. What is the direction he is facing now?
questions.explanation: He will be facing East.

questions.question: A tourist is standing at the bank of river Hooghly in Kolkata. He walks 2 km east along the river, then 4 km south and then 1 km in the west direction. In which direction is he standing now?
questions.explanation: He will be standing in the South direction.

questions.question: A person walks 8 km from a point in the direction of Dakshineswar Temple, then 5 km in the direction of Howrah Bridge and finally 3 km in the north direction. In which direction is he standing now?
questions.explanation: He will be facing East.
